neighbours.label: the preposition by or of where a named leader or author is expected: 'led by', 'under the chairmanship of', 'the novels of'
fire: The army, led by Marshal Ney, crossed the river at dawn.
The committee met under the direction of Dr. Hannah Weiss.
Our book club is reading the poems of Pablo Neruda this month.
The expedition, headed by Ernest Shackleton, sailed in August.
The rebels, led by a young colonel, seized the radio station.
The hospital opened under the leadership of Sister Agnes.
The gallery shows the paintings of Frida Kahlo until May.
The new orchestra, conducted by Lena Berg, played Mahler.
quiet: The army, tired by the march, crossed the river at dawn.
The committee met in the middle of a heavy snowstorm.
Our book club is reading in front of the library this month.
The expedition, delayed by bad weather, sailed in August.
The rebels, hit by a sudden flood, left the radio station.
The hospital opened on the corner of Main Street.
The gallery shows a lot of watercolours until May.
The new orchestra, made up of students, played Mahler.
